envelope.description: Add the read side of ArtifactStore

body.title: Add the read side of ArtifactStore
body.summary: Add src/workflow/artifact-core/store.ts with ArtifactStore.read, readWithHistory and childrenOf over the decoder and History, and enter the store file in the inventory in the same task.
acceptanceChecks: readWithHistory returns identity, description, parent, references, change log, feedback and lifecycle in one shape for an artifact with non-empty history and feedback
an artifact type with no lifecycle part reads an empty part and nothing fails
childrenOf derives children from parent links, skips an unreadable head and stores nothing on the parent
the inventory test passes with the store file entered

tests.name: src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/store-read.test.ts: readWithHistory exposes identity, description, parent, references, change log, feedback and lifecycle in one shape for an artifact with non-empty history and feedback
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/store-read.test.ts: a head with no envelope or lifecycle part reads an empty part and does not fail
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/store-read.test.ts: a reference names its target, type and relation, external targets are accepted, and the parent chain is given by the parent link
src/workflow/artifact-core/__tests__/store-children.test.ts: children are derived from the parent link and are never stored on the parent
